title: Plus Size Gathered Sea-island filament fabircs Evening Dress
descriptionHtml:
This plus size shimmer formal dress is designed with a softly pleated waist and flowing skirt that creates an easy, flattering silhouette. The shimmer fabric adds just enough glow for rehearsal dinners, wedding receptions, formal events and prom nights while still feeling comfortable for hours of wear.


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: Floor-length.


Sleeve Style: Sleeveless.


Closure: Back zipper.


Undergarments: It is not padded, with lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises sea-island filament fabircs.


Stretch: Fabric is non-stretch.
